stem_book: An ideal gas originally at 1.10 atm and 298 K underwent a reversible adiabatic expansion to 1.00 atm and 287 K. What is the molar heat capacity at constant pressure (C_p,m) of the gas? (R = 1.987 cal K⁻¹ mol⁻¹)
correct_answer: C_p,m ≈ 5 cal mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ (5.04; ≈ 21.1 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹)
reason: Added unstated 'ideal gas' and that the asked heat capacity is C_p,m (what the key gives).
